title: Continuum — private local notes on your direct reports (gap falsified by the incumbent)
method: PH submission 2026-08-13, counter-checked against the 1:1-tooling shelf before carding
pain: Review season arrives and a manager with seven reports can remember the last two weeks and nothing else — so the review gets written from recency and vibes, not from what the person actually did in March.
gap: The gap it implies did not survive the counter-check. Fellow already ships private manager notes — one manager says plainly he upgraded to the paid tier precisely to get notes his reports could not see — and Ask Fellow drafts the review from real examples pulled out of every 1:1 transcript. Confab is already the indie 'built by a manager, enterprise tools are too rigid' version. What Continuum owns is the axis, not the job: no ratings, no reports, never leaves the Mac.
kill: Local storage does not make notes safe. Subjective written impressions about named employees are discoverable in employment disputes, and in the EU/UK an employee can subject-access them wherever they sit — a manager's honest 'I think she is bored and will leave' is a liability the moment it is typed. Add the bias mechanism: private impressions accumulate unchallenged and then get spent at promotion time. And by the pain-age test this is an old pain against an old capability — which is why the shelf is already full rather than empty.
move: Nothing to take. The residue — managers whose legal counsel tells them to keep no notes at all — is a reason not to build this, not a wedge.
wallet: 强，且是一手的：有管理者明说「为了拿到下属看不见的私密笔记，我从免费档升到了付费档」，Fellow $7/人/月、Hypercontext $7/人/月、Lattice 企业档——钱确实在流动，只是流向已经在位的产品

zh.pain: 到了写绩效的时候，带七个人的管理者只记得最近两周，其余一片空白——于是评估写的是近因和印象，不是这个人三月份到底做了什么。
zh.gap: 它暗示的缺口没扛过竞品查。Fellow 早就有「下属看不见的私密笔记」，而且有管理者明说他就是为这个从免费档升到付费档；Ask Fellow 还能直接从每次一对一的转写里抓真实例子替你起草评估。Confab 更是现成的「一个管理者嫌企业工具太僵硬，自己做了一个」。Continuum 真正占住的是那根轴，不是那件活：不打分、不出报告、永不离开这台 Mac。
zh.kill: 存在本地不等于安全。关于具名员工的主观文字，在劳动争议里是可调取的；在欧盟英国，员工有权要求查看这些记录，不管它躺在谁的硬盘上——「我觉得她已经无聊了，半年内会走」这句话，敲下去的那一刻就是负债。再加上偏见机制：私下印象无人质疑地累积，然后在晋升时被花掉。而按痛龄尺子，这是老痛 × 老能力——所以货架是满的，不是空的。
zh.move: 没有可拿的东西。剩下的那点残余——法务告诉他「一个字都别记」的管理者——是不做的理由，不是切口。
zh.wallet: 强，且是一手的：有管理者明说「为了拿到下属看不见的私密笔记，我从免费档升到付费档」。钱确实在流动，只是流向已经在位的产品
